create_PI0Config_default: create a PI0Config with default settings for a Pi0 model using PaliGemma and Gemma backbones
create_PI0Config_from_dict: create a PI0Config initialized from a dictionary with custom vlm_config and dit_config parameters
build_PI0_model_with_config: build a PI0ForConditionalGeneration model by passing a PI0Config instance to the constructor
